model_scope: 生有樓2014校方標稱空拍外觀代表，以2025年10月樓層配置交叉核對相對拓樸；非2001精準復原、非2026現況、非全校完成。
counting_note: 71舊包＋418新增目錄包＝489；457校園相關＋32其他＝489。新增目錄105校，加原有聯大為全庫106校；東海教堂與新增目錄東海不重複計校。吳鳳前身不另計校，一套模型不等於全校完成。
publication_evidence: The repository commit containing this record establishes publication; this content record is not a remote upload receipt.
limits: All real dimensions estimated; model 220 x 186 x 114.5 mm including 3 mm base; no 1:N scale.
Unknown two diagonal rear facades are neutral low-detail print shells, not a claim of real blank walls.
Central roof-panel interior enclosure, rounded joints, thickness, window groups and courtyard elevations are disclosed print simplifications.
Retain lower wings, smaller high body, three-storey entrance opening, triangular courtyard galleries and segmented roof voids; no complete additional tenth floor.
Supports, bridge/removal paths and 220 mm bed margins need evaluation; no slicing or physical-print validation.
Finite sections/rays do not establish arbitrary-direction global minimum wall thickness or scaled-model printability.
Original 2^30 parser and failure retained; 2^56 adaptation binds every original binary32 coordinate without mesh/sample replacement.
No original third-party source photos, video frames, PDF, private crops, credentials or Library receipts.
